reaction.episode: Active DIGESTION episode, measured through Friday's close (episode data fresh, through 2026-10-16): SPX closed 7,659.44, -2.36% from its 120-day high of 7,844.52 and -0.61% below its 50-day (7,706.42) but still +5.34% above the 200-day (7,271.44). SMH closed 539.79 (-19.65% from its high) BETWEEN_ZONES after tagging the Zone 1 floor at 540, on 2.60x average volume; NVDA at 214.13 sits ABOVE_ZONE_1 (Zone 1 is 200-210). VIX spiked +21.45% to 19.99 with no rollover, HY OAS is calm at 3.23, and the mechanical capitulation tally is only 1 of 4 (credit calm alone) — no buy-zone occupancy and no capitulation confirmation yet, so nothing on the ladder has triggered.
reaction.invalidation: This Watch stance is wrong in either direction: if SPX reclaims and holds above 7,820 (top of the failure zone) with breadth repairing — IWM stabilizing against SPY after -8.7% over 3 months — the episode has resolved upward and the ladder is void; if HY OAS cracks 4% before any price trigger fires, credit led and the digestion read was wrong, so the stand-down rung should already have fired.

ladder.response: Escalate Watch to Probe: start thesis-verification work on the DATA_AHEAD quality queue (NVDA conviction 82, AVGO, VRT) under the RESEARCH_SCREENED posture — verification first, staged sizing only after the tally confirms.

ladder.response: Reclassify the episode from digestion to correction: halt all adds, run a capital-preservation review of the speculative complex (SMR/ASTS/OKLO/RKLB), and require a 3/4 tally plus a VIX rollover before any Zone 2 probe.

ladder.response: Trap case: do not chase and do not add into the retest. Wait for the failure-zone verdict — a held close above the zone disarms the trap; a rejection returns us to the Zone 1/Zone 2 rungs.
ladder.trigger: A bounce carries SMH into the 580-600 failure zone or SPX into 7,750-7,820 and stalls or rejects there, especially with the 10Y rising during the bounce

ladder.response: Stand down the ladder: rotation has become rollover and credit is confirming — flip to a Trim review of duration-sensitive exposure and stay stood down until credit stabilizes.

ladder.response: Re-entry: promote the verified DATA_AHEAD queue from research to Add candidates in staged size, NVDA first — the dislocation becomes the re-entry queue.

reaction.trapRisk: The working expectation for this episode is pivot-and-fail: a sudden bounce that traps buyers expecting a continued rise. The trap geometry is marked in the episode block — SMH 580-600 and SPX 7,750-7,820 are the failure zones. It changes entries directly: the first bounce off the Zone 1 area is NOT an entry, even on a strong up day. Entries wait for the failure-zone retest verdict — either a rejection that returns price toward Zone 1/2 with the mechanical tally improved beyond 1/4, or a held close above the failure zone that disarms the trap. Chasing the first green move is the exact trade this episode is set up to punish.

strategyPosture: Stay selective and research-first into the weekend: SPY -1.36% and QQQ -2.77% on Friday with VIX 19.98 argue against chasing, while DATA_AHEAD dislocations in AVGO, VRT and NVDA warrant thesis verification under the RESEARCH_SCREENED pullback posture, not automatic sizing. Credit (HY OAS 3.23, SLOOS 0% LOOSE) gives no rollover confirmation to de-risk on.

themes.counterRead: Rotation is real at the top but it is not broadening downward: IWM is -1.90% today, -5.45% on the month and -8.7% over 3 months, and the VIX jumped +21.39% today to 19.98 (+29.4% on the month). Index calm is masking churn underneath, and the divergence becomes a rollover signal if credit flips from loose.

themes.label: Leadership rotation, not rollover

themes.counterRead: Credit is not validating a policy-error spiral: HY OAS at 3.23 is calm and the curve is bear-steepening in an orderly way, not disorderly. Duration multiples are being repriced, but nothing in the credit data says the tightening is breaking borrowers yet.
themes.dataAnchor: The constraint is real rates, not inflation expectations: 10Y at 5.10%, 30Y at 5.44%, real 10Y at 2.75% while breakeven inflation is only 2.35%. The curve is positive (2s10s +0.33) with DFF at 3.88 and the 2Y at 4.77, and the next decision point is the FOMC on Oct 27-28.
themes.label: Restrictive real rates into the FOMC
themes.narrative: After the Sep CPI event (Oct 14, HIGH signal) and a hot PPI read, the market narrative is a Fed with no room to ease — rate-hike jitters drove Friday's Nasdaq-led selloff (QQQ -2.77% vs SPY -1.36%).
themes.watchFor: A 10Y sustained above ~5.25-5.5% or HY OAS widening through 4% into the Oct 27-28 FOMC changes the posture from selective to defensive.

themes.counterRead: Fundamentals are ahead of price here, which is the DATA_AHEAD setup — but it is a research queue, not a buy list: the pullback posture is RESEARCH_SCREENED (verify thesis before sizing), several names in the same screen (APP -63.9%, KTOS -69.8%) show how far sentiment unwinds can run, and a 5.10% 10Y keeps compressing the multiples these names re-rate on.

That distinction matters: it argues against chasing the bounce and against shorting the quality name (VST) with the speculative ones.

If real yields back off after the FOMC, this leadership likely underperforms the rebound — own it as ballast, not as the growth engine.
